reason: I'd poke at the free plan, but I won't pay in month one. A cute mascot on my site risks looking like exactly the generic widget I hate, and I'd need proof it lifts sign-ups before adding another subscription.
objection: Will it match my brand and design, or will it feel like a bolted-on widget that visitors ignore while I pay monthly for it?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the mascot fully restyled to my brand on my own site (not a stock character), plus a real A/B result from a comparable SaaS showing measurable sign-up lift.
